section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Sarnen; other communes differ) and church tax
label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Sarnen; other communes in Obwalden set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
value: None in the cantonal tax law: the land taxes it provides are the property gains tax and the transfer tax
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 142 and the minimum tax on real estate

label: Minimum tax on real estate
value: A fixed minimum tax of 2 per mille of the net tax value of real estate replaces the ordinary taxes where it is higher (legal entities and natural persons)
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 142 and the minimum tax on real estate

label: Transfer tax rate (share of the property value)
note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 158-163

label: Who pays
value: Seller and buyer, half each, unless agreed otherwise (yield shared half and half between canton and municipality)
note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
source_title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 158-163
